_about: What the installed Dagster defines that the sensor does not forward, each with the reason. Read by test_backward.py; a name absent from the installed version is simply unused there.

event_types.ALERT_FAILURE: Dagster+ alert delivery, about the alert rather than the run.
event_types.ALERT_START: Dagster+ alert delivery, about the alert rather than the run.
event_types.ALERT_SUCCESS: Dagster+ alert delivery, about the alert rather than the run.
event_types.ASSET_CHECK_EVALUATION_PLANNED: Only that a check will run; its ASSET_CHECK_EVALUATION says what it found.
event_types.ASSET_FAILED_TO_MATERIALIZE: The step's STEP_FAILURE and the execution plan's asset outputs already say which assets a failed step did not write.
event_types.ASSET_HEALTH_CHANGED: Written by the Dagster+ daemon outside any run; a run-status sensor never sees it.
event_types.ASSET_MATERIALIZATION_PLANNED: Only that an asset will be written; its ASSET_MATERIALIZATION says what was.
event_types.ASSET_STORE_OPERATION: The IO manager's own bookkeeping; HANDLED_OUTPUT and LOADED_INPUT carry the same path metadata.
event_types.ASSET_WIPED: A user wiping an asset's history in the UI, outside any run.
event_types.CODE_LOCATION_UPDATED: A code location reloading, outside any run.
event_types.ENGINE_EVENT: Executor chatter (process started, steps finished); the step stats carry each step's start and end.
event_types.FRESHNESS_STATE_CHANGE: Written by the freshness daemon outside any run; a run-status sensor never sees it.
event_types.FRESHNESS_STATE_EVALUATION: Written by the freshness daemon outside any run; a run-status sensor never sees it.
event_types.HOOK_COMPLETED: A success or failure hook ran; says nothing about the data.
event_types.HOOK_ERRORED: A hook raised; the run's own outcome is unaffected and crosses anyway.
event_types.HOOK_SKIPPED: A hook did not run; says nothing about the data.
event_types.LOGS_CAPTURED: Where compute logs were written: local file paths, and the logs are free text.
event_types.OBJECT_STORE_OPERATION: The legacy intermediate store's bookkeeping; HANDLED_OUTPUT and LOADED_INPUT carry the path.
event_types.RESOURCE_INIT_FAILURE: A resource that fails to start fails its step, whose STEP_FAILURE carries the error.
event_types.RESOURCE_INIT_STARTED: Only that a resource began to start; RESOURCE_INIT_SUCCESS is forwarded.
event_types.RUN_CANCELING: An intermediate status; the sensor reports a run once it is over.
event_types.RUN_DEQUEUED: An intermediate status; the sensor reports a run once it is over.
event_types.RUN_ENQUEUED: An intermediate status; the run stats' enqueued_time says when.
event_types.RUN_START: An intermediate status; the run stats' start_time says when.
event_types.RUN_STARTING: An intermediate status; the run stats' launch_time says when.
event_types.STEP_EXPECTATION_RESULT: Already in the step stats' expectation_results and the run stats' expectations.
event_types.STEP_INPUT: A type check on an in-memory value; the execution plan says which step feeds which.
event_types.STEP_OUTPUT: A type check on an in-memory value; HANDLED_OUTPUT and the materialisation say where it went.
event_types.STEP_RESTARTED: Already in the step stats' attempts and attempts_list.
event_types.STEP_SKIPPED: Already in the step stats' status.
event_types.STEP_START: Already in the step stats' start_time.
event_types.STEP_SUCCESS: Already in the step stats' status and end_time.
event_types.STEP_UP_FOR_RETRY: Already in the step stats' attempts; the final attempt's outcome is what a receiver needs.
event_types.STEP_WORKER_STARTED: Executor chatter about the step's process.
event_types.STEP_WORKER_STARTING: Executor chatter about the step's process.

metadata_types.CodeLocationReconstructionMetadataValue: Dagster's own code-location state, not an asset's.
metadata_types.CodeReferencesMetadataValue: Links to the asset's source files; the run's origin already names the code location, file and module.
metadata_types.DagsterAssetMetadataValue: A link to another asset in the UI; carries no lineage Dagster itself acts on. Redacted as author metadata.
metadata_types.DagsterJobMetadataValue: A link to a job in the UI. Redacted as author metadata.
metadata_types.DagsterRunMetadataValue: A link to a run in the UI. Redacted as author metadata.
metadata_types.JsonMetadataValue: Author-written free JSON: the widest sample surface. Redacted.
metadata_types.MarkdownMetadataValue: Author-written free text, often a preview of rows. Redacted.
metadata_types.ObjectMetadataValue: The repr of an arbitrary Python object. Redacted.
metadata_types.PoolMetadataValue: A concurrency pool name, about scheduling rather than data.
metadata_types.PythonArtifactMetadataValue: A Python import path an author chose to show; not the asset's code, which the origin names. Redacted.
metadata_types.TableMetadataValue: Rows of a table: a data sample. Redacted; its schema crosses as dagster/column_schema.

metadata_keys.dagster/code_references: Links to the asset's source files; the run's origin already names the code location, file and module.
